executive_summary: Our Lamborghini platform continues to demonstrate strong inherent pace and excellent tire management, positioning us as a formidable force on track. However, pit stop efficiency remains a critical differentiator among competitors, with Flying Lizard Motorsports showing a significant operational advantage. We also have clear opportunities for individual driver performance gains, notably addressing the large pace gap observed within Car #46 to maximize overall team potential.

The Human Machine: How Precision Pit Stops Are Defining Race Day Victories.
